statusSemantics.complete: The requirement has repository and, where applicable, immutable operational evidence.
statusSemantics.partial: Some implementation or evidence exists, but at least one named gate remains open.
statusSemantics.not_started: No qualifying implementation or immutable evidence exists yet.
statusSemantics.phaseRule: A phase is complete only when every requirement is complete; it is not_started only when every requirement is not_started; otherwise it is in_progress.

claimPolicy: Repository tests do not prove TradingView compilation, saved-source parity, bindings, alerts, or layout state.
A planned surface stays outside managed save and verification targets until immutable live evidence exists.
No phase may be marked complete from a PR merge alone when its exit criteria require operational evidence.

requirements.description: Every root Pine surface is classified by the canonical registry and orphan gates.
The eight saved sources, seven BUS consumers, bindings, layout, alert inventory, and rollback target have immutable read-only evidence.
Event time is an absolute DST-aware America/New_York timestamp and is not conflated with the restriction-window start.
Exit Signal consumes schema, lifecycle, trigger, invalidation, stop, and both Engine BUS targets and fails closed before fill.
Deterministic TradingView replay proves single alert edges, same-bar precedence, gap behavior, and no duplicate actionable exit mode.
Event Overlay and Exit Signal compile, save, bind, hash-verify, and enter the intended managed layout.

phases.name: Hold Manager standard readiness and rollout

requirements.description: Engine BUS v2 is the fail-closed primary plan and manual entry is an explicit fallback.
Entry epoch, protected high, target state, active stop, terminal exit, reload, and new-plan identity reconstruct deterministically.
All twenty plan replay cases pass with no false or duplicate exit alert.
Hold Manager completes shadow observation and becomes Advanced standard without duplicate actionable Exit Signal alerts.
openGates: Shadow activated 2026-07-28T22:41Z at the post-close session boundary (HOLD_MANAGER_SHADOW_ACCEPTING=1, deployment 059b2883-3e5e-44ad-a781-d3f12c46fb51, state readback accepting=true with an empty ledger; evidence: artifacts/governance/smc_hold_manager_shadow_activation_2026-07-28.json). Record the first five complete XNYS sessions in activation order without cherry-picking (first evaluable session 2026-07-29); delivered server-alert counts are reconciled from the receiver ledger via scripts/reconcile_smc_hold_manager_shadow_deliveries.py; the comparison and exclusivity gates must pass. The rollback drill is operator-pre-authorized and executes only after the observation criteria pass; no external TradingView publication is required.

requirements.description: Structure, Imbalance, and Zone frames exist with source and golden-contract tests.
Sweep, Pool, Session, and aggregate Context frames are implemented with parity evidence.
openGates: All four repository frames, Python-golden rule parity, Pine-only detection semantics, and deterministic replay vectors are implemented. TradingView compile and redacted Pine runtime replay remain required before this gate can be complete.

requirements.description: The complete library compiles, is published in dependency order, and has immutable version/facade evidence.
openGates: Current repository contains a publisher but no immutable evidence for a complete R3 library.

phases.name: Context BUS and Context Overlay shadow

requirements.description: Context BUS schema 8001 is implemented with at most 60 channels and at least four reserves.
Context Overlay is implemented, bound, performance-gated, and compared in a shadow layout.
The confirmed-bar request.security spike passes timeframe, session, DST, repaint, and performance cases.
openGates: Run the R5 HTF technical spike before replacing the snapshot implementation.

openGates: Do not promote the known-broken snapshot consumer.
